# telnyx_storage_cloudfs_filesystems (Data Source)

Lists storage cloudfs filesystems, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_storage_cloudfs_filesystem`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_name` (String)
- `filter_region` (String)
- `filter_status` (String) One of `deleting`, `failed`, `needs_format`, `provisioning`, `ready`.
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.
- `sort` (String) One of `-created_at`, `-name`, `-updated_at`, `created_at`, `name`, `updated_at`.

### Read-Only

- `storage_cloudfs_filesystems` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--storage_cloudfs_filesystems))

<a id="nestedatt--storage_cloudfs_filesystems"></a>
### Nested Schema for `storage_cloudfs_filesystems`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `record_type` (String)
- `region` (String)
- `s3_bucket` (String) Name of the bucket that stores this filesystem's data. Created during provisioning.
- `s3_endpoint` (String) URL of the Telnyx Cloud Storage endpoint backing this filesystem.
- `status` (String) Lifecycle status of the filesystem. `ready` means it is fully provisioned and usable. `needs_format` means the storage bucket and metadata database were provisioned but the filesystem has not yet been formatted — run `juicefs format` with the filesystem's `meta_url` before mounting. `failed` means the last lifecycle action failed — see the filesystem's `error` message. `deleted` appears only in the delete response: deleted filesystems are excluded from list results and return a `404` on retrieval.
- `updated_at` (String)
